capability: Partition local CUE/WAVE source sample frames into track, recorded-pregap and unassigned intervals.
user: Audio archivists checking how a CUE sheet would divide an uncompressed disc image.
pain: A split plan should explain recorded gaps and account for every source frame before any encoder runs.
expected: The generator writes invented silence into a new directory. The plan exits 0 and covers [0,44100) track 1, [44100,88200) recorded pregap, and [88200,176400) track 2. Planning does not modify source files.
contract: UTF-8 CUE with quoted basename-only FILE WAVE, consecutive AUDIO tracks and INDEX 01 plus optional preceding INDEX 00. Actual little-endian RIFF/WAVE PCM or IEEE_FLOAT metadata determines sample rate, frame alignment, data bounds and byte offsets. CUE indices are 75 frames/second and must map to integer sample-frame boundaries exactly. A sample frame contains all channels. Intervals use exclusive ends and cover each source frame exactly once, including explicit unassigned leading audio findings. SHA256 identifies source bytes.
limits: CUE 64 KiB, 16 local files, 99 tracks, 64 MiB per WAVE/128 MiB aggregate. No symlinks or path traversal, compressed audio, RF64/RIFX/extensible WAVE, synthetic PREGAP/POSTGAP, extra indices, copying, transcoding, resampling, tags or audio quality assessment. Unknown RIFF chunks are counted. --make-example only creates a new directory and refuses overwrite.
acceptance: Prove exact contiguous frame coverage, explicit INDEX00 gaps and leading findings, stereo byte offsets, source-byte preservation, RIFF validation, and rejection of unrepresentable frame boundaries and unsafe paths.
notes: Flacon already extracts and tags tracks from disc images. FFcuesplitter supports broader audio formats and text encodings. split2flac is archived and its README points to a replacement; it is a historical alternative, not presented as maintained. Flacon cue.cpp already treats INDEX00 and INDEX01. Our read-only sample accounting intentionally omits splitting and compressed formats.
alternatives: Flacon or FFcuesplitter for actual extraction; inspect the CUE manually before choosing an encoder.
overlap: The existing medialoom repository catalogs media metadata. This tool reads CUE index semantics and actual RIFF binary data to construct a complete source-frame partition, rather than another catalog.
